_about: Toolkit-wide settings for the Dataverse write path. cli_version: the Dataverse CLI version doctor expects (pinned 1.0.81 on 10/7/26: pin current, update as we see fit in the toolkit. On SBRM Windows machines each new version is a new file ThreatLocker must approve). warn_rows: there is NO cap on how much one approval may change (ruled 10/7/26); a change to more than this many rows, pairs or objects is flagged 'Large change' at plan and in the pop-up (DESIGN.md 10j). dev_dirs: folders where the engine itself is developed; the guard lets code there reference the engine's write side, which it refuses everywhere else. Ships EMPTY (no internal paths in the public repo). Since 1.10.0 a developer's folders live in ~/.sbrm-dataverse/config/dev_dirs.json on their own machine (guard-protected, survives toolkit updates); this list is still read for older setups. Version check-ins (1.11.9, DESIGN.md 12, knobs ruled 10/12/26): release_url is where main's plugin.json is read; checkin_grace_min is how long a session must run with the install behind main before the automatic update counts as stuck; checkin_interval_min is how often each machine re-checks; checkin_pending_days is how long a release may go uninstalled before the review warns; checkin_machine_days is how long a silent machine stays graded; reload_plugins_applies turns the nudge's wording from 'quit and reopen' to '/reload-plugins' once that is measured to load an update (DESIGN.md 12f).
